mapper.select: SELECT ROUTE_NAME,MENU_NAME FROM A1MFG.SYS_MENU_LIST WHERE MENU_TYPE ='page' AND (PATH LIKE '%n1mfg%' OR UPPER(PATH) NOT LIKE '%HTTP%' or PATH LIKE '%10.51.184.201%')

SELECT EMP_ID,CNAME,EMAIL FROM WORKFLOW.HR_USERS WHERE QUIT_DATE IS NULL AND BYWORK ='0' AND EMAIL IS NOT NULL
AND (EMP_ID LIKE CONCAT(#{query},'%') OR CNAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{query},'%')) OR EMAIL LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{query},'%')))
AND (DEPT_ID = 'PB11' OR DEPT_ID = 'PH11' OR DEPT_ID = 'PT11')
SELECT EMP_ID,CNAME,EMAIL FROM WORKFLOW.HR_USERS WHERE QUIT_DATE IS NULL AND BYWORK ='0' AND EMAIL IS NOT NULL AND DEPT_ID = 'PB11'
SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_ID,SDEPT_CNAME,DEPT_CNAME FROM WORKFLOW.HR_USERS WHERE QUIT_DATE IS NULL AND BYWORK ='0' AND EMAIL IS NOT NULL AND SDEPT_CNAME IS NOT NULL AND DEPT_CNAME IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_ID,DEPT_CNAME FROM WORKFLOW.HR_USERS WHERE QUIT_DATE IS NULL AND BYWORK ='0' AND EMAIL IS NOT NULL AND SDEPT_CNAME IS NOT NULL

SELECT DEPT_ID||DECODE(SUBDEPT_ID,NULL,NULL,'-')|| DECODE(SUBDEPT_ID,NULL,NULL,SUBDEPT_ID) SDEPT_ID, DEPT_CNAME||DECODE(SDEPT_CNAME,NULL,NULL,'(')||DECODE(SDEPT_CNAME,NULL,NULL,SDEPT_CNAME)||DECODE(SDEPT_CNAME,NULL,NULL,')')SDEPT_CNAME FROM( SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_ID,SUBDEPT_ID,DEPT_CNAME,SDEPT_CNAME FROM WORKFLOW.HR_USERS WHERE QUIT_DATE IS NULL AND BYWORK ='0' AND EMAIL IS NOT NULL )
